title: Shark doesn't live up to the hype
text: Shark doesn't live up to the hype. Full disclosure: did not purchase from Amazon but rather, brand new item from Target. Outside of the warranty period (it's less than 2 years old) and the cord (on the inside where you can't see it) has a short and the iron either (a) turns off or (b) switches to the lowest heat setting.  Super annoying since this was on the pricier side, and totally soured me on Shark products. It also started to leak water about three months ago while ironing on the "steam" setting.
